verses.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.sm: O tuaoi o fanua Iosua, ua tele ona tausaga; ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII ia te ia, Ua e toeaina lava, ua tele ou tausaga; e matua tele foi le laueleele o totoe e fai mo outou.

verses.en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.sm: O le laueleele lenei o totoe; o le itu uma o Filisitia, ma Kasuri uma,

verses.en: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.sm: e afua mai i Seora, e feagai ma Aikupito, a e oo atu i le tuaoi o Ekerona i le itu i matu, ua ta'ua ia o sa Kanana; o alii e toalima o Filisitia; o tagata o Kasa, ma tagata o Asetota, o tagata o Asekelona, o tagata o Kata, ma tagata o Ekerona, ma tagata o Gavi;

verses.en: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
verses.sm: e afua mai ile itu i toga, o le nuu uma o sa Kananá, ma Meara o i sa Saitonú, e oo atu i Afeka, e oo i le tuaoi o sa Amori;

verses.en: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.sm: o le nuu foi o tagata o Kivali, ma Lepanona uma i le itu e alu ae ai le la, e afua mai i Paalakato o i lalo o le inauga o Heremone, e oo i le mea e ui atu ai i Amato.

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.sm: Ou te tulia i luna o le fanauga a Isaraelu o e nonofo uma i le atu mauga e afua mai i Lepanona, e oo atu i Meserefomaima, o tagata uma o Saitonu; tau ina e fai ai le vili ia Isaraelu e totofi ai le laueleele, e pei ona ou fai atu ai ía te oe.

verses.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e vaevaeina atu lenei laueleele e fai ma tofi mo itu aiga e iva, ma le vaega o le itu aiga o Manase.

verses.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
verses.sm: O sa Reupena, ma sa Kato, ua maua e i latou o latou tofi faatasi ma i latou, na avatu e Mose ia te i latou i le la itu i sasae O Ioritana, e pei ona avatu ia te i latou e Mose le auauna a le ALII;

verses.en: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.sm: e afua mai i Aroeru, o i le auvai o le alia o Arinona, ma le aai o i totonu o le alia, ma le eleele laugatasi uma o Metepa, e oo atu i Tipona;

verses.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.sm: o aai uma foi o Sekono le tupu o sa Amori, o le na fai ma tupu i Hesepona, e oo i le tuaoi o le fanauga a Amoni;

verses.en: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.sm: o Kiliata foi, ma le nuu o tagata o Kasuri, ma tagata o Maaka, ma le mauga o Heremoni uma, ma Vasana uma e oo atu i Saleka.

verses.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.sm: O le malo uma o Oko i Vasana, o le na toe i sa Rafa, o le na fai ma tupu i Aserota, ma Eterei; na fasia foi i latou e Mose, ma tulia i latou.

verses.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.sm: Na le tulia foi e le fanauga a Isaraelu tagata o Kasuri, ma tagata o Maaka; a ua nonofo Kasuri, ma Maaka faatasi ma Isaraelu, e oo lava i le aso nei.

verses.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.sm: Na o le itu aiga o sa Levi, na ia le avatu ai se tofi; o taulaga e fai i le afi i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu o lo latou tofi lea, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.sm: Na avatu e Mose le tofi i le itu aiga o le fanauga a Reupena e tusa ma o latou aiga;

verses.en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.sm: e afua mai foi lo latou tuaoi i Aroeru, o i le auvai o le alia o Arinona, ma le aai o i totonu o le alia, ma le eleele laugatasi uma o i Metepa;

verses.en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.sm: o Hesepona, ma ona aai uma o i le eleele laugatasi; o Tipona, ma Pamotapaala, ma Petepaalameona,

verses.en: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.sm: ma laesa ma Katemoti, ma Mefata,

verses.en: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.sm: ma Kiriataima, ma Sepema, ma Saretasaara o i le mauga o le vanu,

verses.en: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.sm: ma Petepeoro, ma Asetotapeseka, ma Petesemota;

verses.en: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.sm: 0 aai uma foi i le eleele laugatasi, ma le malo uma o Sekono le tupu o sa Amori, o le na fai ma tupu i Hesepona, na fasia o ia e Mose faatasi ma alii sili o Mitiana, o Evi, ma Rekema, ma Suro, ma Huro, ma Repa, o alii sa ia Sekono, sa nonofo i le nuu.

verses.en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.sm: O Palaamo foi le atalii o Peoro, o le na fai togafiti faataulaitu, na fasiotia e le fanauga a Isaraelu i le pelu faatasi ma e na latou fasia.

verses.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.sm: O le tuaoi o le fanauga a Reupena o Ioritana lea, ma ona tuaoi. O le tofi lea o le fanauga a Reupena e tusa ma o latou aiga, o aai ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.sm: Na avatu e Mose le tofi i le itu aiga o Kato, o le fanauga a Kato, e tusa ma o latou aiga.

verses.en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.sm: O lo latou tuaoi o lasaru, ma aai uma o Kiliata, ma le vaeluaga o le laueleele o le fanauga a Amoni, e 00 atu i Aroeru, e feagai ma Rapa;

verses.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.sm: e afua mai foi Hesepona, e oo atu i Ramamesepa; ma Patanima; e afua mai foi i Maanaima e oo atu i le tuaoi o Tiperi;

verses.en: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.sm: o aai foi i le vanu, O Petearama, ma Petenimara, ma Sukota, ma Sefono, o toe o le malo o Sekono le tupu o Hesepona, o loritana ma ona tuaoi, e oo atu i le mea e gata mai ai le vai o Kinereta i le la itu i sasae o loritana.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.sm: O le tofi lea o le fanauga a Kato e tusa ma o latou aiga, o aai ma o latou faoa aai.

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.sm: Na avatu e Mose le tofi i le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase; o le tofi lenei o le vaega o le itu aiga O le fanauga a Manase e tusa ma O latou aiga.

verses.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.sm: O latou tuaoi e afua mai Maanaima, o Vasana uma, O le malo uma o Oko le tupu o Vasana, ma Havota-iario uma o i Vasana, o aai e onogafulu;

verses.en: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.sm: ma le tasi itu o Kiliata, ma Aserota, ma Eterei, o aai o le malo o Oko i Vasana, na i ai i le fanauga a Makiro le atalii o Manase, o le vaeluaga o le fanauga a Makiro e tusa ma o latou aiga.

verses.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.sm: O nuu ia na tofia e Mose mo i latou i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi, ile la itu o Ioritana, e feagai ma Ieriko i sasae.

verses.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.sm: A ua le avatu e Mose se tofi i le itu aiga o sa Levi; o le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu o ia lo latou tofi, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o ia
